# Authorized toolset and AI-room transport bootstrap

This directory is a nonproduct, one-time genesis instrument. It exists only to construct, verify, and terminate the temporary authority needed to install repository-authorized toolset resolution and AI-room execution transport.

## Mandatory boundaries

- Only the exact paths in `changed-path-manifest.v1.json` may change.
- No product, Laws, Showroom, H-Earth, assignment-state, deployment, or release path may change.
- An issue or comment may supply only a descriptor identity and schema-valid inputs. It may never supply a shell command, script body, workflow override, path override, or environment override.
- The dispatcher must reload and verify the registered descriptor before executing its fixed command.
- Every attempted execution must return a command-emitted receipt or a fail-closed nonexecution receipt.
- Missing or invalid receipts stop continuation.
- Builder output requires fresh independent reproduction. The verifier may not repair it.
- Permanent activation and merge require separate ratification.
- Temporary bootstrap authority must terminate without residue after successful certification.
